Seven explicit generators have rank 7 and reproduce source ordinary weights 1+31z16+32z17+31z20+32z21+z36. Every r-subspace of message space F2^7 has a unique RREF basis; independent exhaustive enumeration of counts 127,2667,11811,11811,2667,127,1 (total 29211) computes each support by bitwise OR of corresponding words. All detailed histograms in RESULT.md and source artifacts/certificate.json reproduced, yielding generalized Hamming weights (16,24,28,32,34,36,37) and minimizers (31,75,15,45,10,37,1). Source code and certificate inspected, independent checker executed. It is a complete finite proof, not extrapolation.
